facts.text: Jolene compares the experience of yoga to hitting the refresh button and coming back even better.

evidence.quote: Got it! It's like hitting the refresh button and coming back even better.

facts.text: Jolene mentions that she enjoys the savasana pose for its calming effects and ability to help her let go and surrender.

evidence.quote: I'm a fan of savasana - aka the corpse pose. It's so calming and helps me just let go and surrender.

facts.text: Jolene states that she has been practicing yoga for 3 years as a way to escape studying and work stress.

evidence.quote: Been doing it for 3 years. It's a great way to escape studying and work stress.
